relTest.notes:
• Projects are listed by inspection date, grouped by month, with the date or date range of each project (a commercial job shows its full range).
• Library → Company & inspector: company, inspector, title / credentials, license, logo and signature in one place. The Word report prints your signature and title.
• Shot list: the photos to take on every inspection (elevations, address, a roof slope with its pitch…). They tick themselves as you take them; 📸 Shots in the area box shows what's left, Needs attention lists it, and the phone reminds you when you switch projects.
• Everything in one file: download your whole setup (Library, settings, company profiles, report templates) and restore it on another phone or computer.
• Windows / Mac: every backup also makes the project's complete archive, so you can free the phone right away; every backed-up project shows on This computer.
